title: Rizia/Turn 10/RESIGNATIONS
description:
HUGO, LUCITA AND/OR TADDEUS IS ON COUNCIL AND YOU CONQUERED THEIR HOUSE WITHOUT ARRESTING OR KILLING THEM

THEY RESIGN

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat at the head of the long table..."
entries.dialogueText: I sat at the head of the long table in my council chambers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo and my security councilor sat..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo and my security councilor sat across from me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My security councilor sat across fr..."
entries.dialogueText: My security councilor sat across from me, looking despondent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo sat across from me, a hollow l..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo sat across from me, a hollow look in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty... it is done.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... it is done."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""All members of House Toras have re..."
entries.dialogueText: "All members of House Toras have relinquished their titles and estates."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With the exception of the Crown Pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the exception of the Crown Princess, who shall remain in Monqiz but will no longer reign over the province."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Valenqiris is entirely yours.""
entries.dialogueText: "Valenqiris is entirely yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope this has taught you all a v..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope this has taught you all a valuable lesson."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita nodded despondently."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita nodded despondently.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Taddeus nodded despondently."
entries.dialogueText: Taddeus nodded despondently.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The same goes for my home province..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same goes for my home province, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As is my home province, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "As is my home province, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The Azaros have ceded control of C..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros have ceded control of Cardesse-Montaklar. Our lands are officially the property of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""The Azaros have ceded control of C..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Azaros have ceded control of Cardesse-Montaklar. Our lands are officially the property of the Crown."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It is done, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is done, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""It is done, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is done, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your province's armed forces answe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your province's armed forces answer directly to me now as well. Don't forget that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am sorry. I truly didn't mean fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry. I truly didn't mean for all this to happen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Power corrupts. You will thank me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Power corrupts. You will thank me for this in the end."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Great. So what are you still doing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Great. So what are you still doing here?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have come to hand in my official..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have come to hand in my official resignation. I can no longer serve as your Grand Vizier after my family's disgrace."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our cousin Hubertus no longer reig..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our cousin Hubertus no longer reigns over the province. He's scraped together what funds he can and intends to continue his world travels."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle had a hollow look in his e..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle had a hollow look in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""From this point on, we will live a..."
entries.dialogueText: "From this point on, we will live as commoners."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We are to live as commoners.""
entries.dialogueText: "We are to live as commoners."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hate to entrust anyone else with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hate to entrust anyone else with our kingdom's national security. But you'll understand why I cannot remain on the Royal Council."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And every moment I spend in Porte..."
entries.dialogueText: "And every moment I spend in Porte Drazon is a crushing reminder of my son's fate..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And every moment I spend in Porte..."
entries.dialogueText: "And every moment I spend in Porte Drazon is a crushing reminder of the shame I endured..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Without question.""
entries.dialogueText: "Without question."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes. It has.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. It has."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Indeed. Neither I nor any other Az..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Neither I nor any other Azaro will ever challenge your power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They are yours to command.""
entries.dialogueText: "They are yours to command."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Their allegiance is strictly to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their allegiance is strictly to the Crown now."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Their allegiance is to the Crown,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their allegiance is to the Crown, as it always was."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am not complaining, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am not complaining, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You expect me to *thank* you?! I--""
entries.dialogueText: "You expect me to *thank* you?! I--"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yours is the judgement around whic..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yours is the judgement around which this kingdom revolves. I will not question it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes, Your Majesty. Perhaps I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Perhaps I will."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She caught herself."
entries.dialogueText: She caught herself.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should have done more to secure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should have done more to secure the rest of House Toras' allegiance. The fault is mine."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What happened at the birthday gath..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happened at the birthday gathering felt quite deliberate to me, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My daughter started all this when..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter started all this when she betrayed our kingdom. We deserve our punishment."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo placed both of his hands on th..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo placed both of his hands on the table, palms up in a sign of supplication.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's face filled with resolve."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's face filled with resolve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Regret was etched into Taddeus' fea..."
entries.dialogueText: Regret was etched into Taddeus' features.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Carlos, my father and I will conti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos, my father and I will continue to see the Pales war through. But my service to the Kingdom will end there."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Carlos and I will continue to see..."
entries.dialogueText: "Carlos and I will continue to see the Pales war through. But my service to the Kingdom will end there."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""My father may not have many years..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father may not have many years left in him. I'll return to Cardesse-Montaklar and to my family."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I know I risk receiving the same f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know I risk receiving the same fate as my father. But I hope you will let me go in peace."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""All my life, I believed I was dest..."
entries.dialogueText: "All my life, I believed I was destined for greatness. But here I am, Your Majesty. A broken man."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I deserve neither my noble title,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I deserve neither my noble title, my rank nor my position on this council. I am nothing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Go, then. But I will never forget..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go, then. But I will never forget your act of cowardice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I expect nothing less than a compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect nothing less than a complete and total victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have failed me as you have fai..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have failed me as you have failed Rizia. Your name shall be written out of the history books."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Despite the circumstances, I thank..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the circumstances, I thank you both for your years of service."
